slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the requirement that total weekly profit be at least 3000 yuan a hard constraint that must be satisfied, or is it the objective to maximize profit with 3000 yuan as a minimum threshold?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether profit maximization was the objective, and later flagged the missing objective as an assumption needing confirmation.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about idle-time minimization before the user volunteered it; later questions at turns 10-11 merely clarified the volunteered multi-objective and thus receive no proactive-recovery credit.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The problem was initially treated as a feasibility-only integer program, or at most as a profit-related problem, with no idle-time minimization objective.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: At the first READY_TO_MODEL the agent listed no idle-time objective and explicitly assumed no other hidden constraints, without having asked about idle time; the user had not yet stated it.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The first READY_TO_MODEL at turn 9 occurred before the idle-time objective was asked about or confirmed; H2 was later supplied only by the user, so the agent had stopped prematurely with a P1-related gap.

summary: The agent asked about the profit objective and confirmed many constraints, but it missed the idle-time minimization objective and only incorporated it after the user volunteered it; the initial READY_TO_MODEL was therefore premature.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
